To use the following script call in the overdrive system  below, use this in the events... $game_actors[1].gain_overdrive(50)
This next part deactivates overdrive... (Also in events)
$game_actors[1].deactivate_overdrive
Example Formula:
a.atk * (a.overdrive_active? ? 2.0 : 1.0)
The script is here ..
Code:
#==============================================================================
# ■ Dynamic Overdrive System
#    Author: UndeadGamez
#    Engine: RPG Maker VX Ace (RGSS3)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Adds an Overdrive gauge to actors that fills through combat.
# When full, the actor enters Overdrive Mode with boosted stats.
#==============================================================================

module Overdrive
  MAX_GAUGE = 100
  DAMAGE_GAIN = 0.15 # % of damage taken converted to gauge
  ATTACK_GAIN = 0.10 # % of damage dealt converted to gauge
  TURN_DRAIN = 20 # Gauge lost per turn while overdrive is active

  PARAM_BOOST = {
    :atk => 1.30,
    :def => 1.20,
    :agi => 1.25,
    :mat => 1.30,
    :mdf => 1.20
  }
end

#==============================================================================
# ■ Game_Actor
#==============================================================================

class Game_Actor < Game_Battler
  attr_reader verdrive

  alias od_initialize initialize
  def initialize(actor_id)
    od_initialize(actor_id)
    @overdrive = 0
    @overdrive_active = false
  end

  def gain_overdrive(amount)
    return if @overdrive_active
    @overdrive= [[@overdrive + amount, 0].max, Overdrive::MAX_GAUGE].min
    activate_overdrive if @overdrive >= Overdrive::MAX_GAUGE
  end

  def activate_overdrive
    @overdrive_active = true
  end

  def deactivate_overdrive
    @overdrive_active = false
    @overdrive = 0
  end

  def overdrive_active?
    @overdrive_active
  end

  alias od_on_turn_end on_turn_end
  def on_turn_end
    od_on_turn_end
    if @overdrive_active
      @overdrive -= Overdrive::TURN_DRAIN
      deactivate_overdrive if @overdrive <= 0
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ■ Game_Battler
#==============================================================================

class Game_Battler < Game_BattlerBase
  alias od_execute_damage execute_damage
  def execute_damage(user)
    damage = @result.hp_damage
    od_execute_damage(user)

    if self.is_a?(Game_Actor) && damage > 0
      gain = (damage * Overdrive:AMAGE_GAIN).to_i
      self.gain_overdrive(gain)
    end

    if user.is_a?(Game_Actor) && damage > 0
      gain = (damage * Overdrive::ATTACK_GAIN).to_i
      user.gain_overdrive(gain)
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ■ Game_BattlerBase (Stat Boosts)
#==============================================================================

class Game_BattlerBase
  alias od_param param
  def param(param_id)
    value = od_param(param_id)
    return value unless actor? && overdrive_active?

    case param_id
    when 2 then value * Overdrive:ARAM_BOOST[:atk]
    when 3 then value * Overdrive:ARAM_BOOST[:def]
    when 4 then value * Overdrive:ARAM_BOOST[:mat]
    when 5 then value * Overdrive:ARAM_BOOST[:mdf]
    when 6 then value * Overdrive:ARAM_BOOST[:agi]
    else value
    end.to_i
  end
end

#==================================================
# OVERDRIVE SYSTEM - COMPLETE
# RPG Maker VX Ace
# RGSS3
#Author: Undeadgamez
#
# -----------------------------
# TUTORIAL / HOW TO USE
# -----------------------------
#
# 1. WHAT THIS SCRIPT DOES
# -----------------------------
# This script adds an Overdrive (Limit Break) system.
#
# - Actors gain Overdrive when:
#   - Using skills or items
#   - Taking damage
#
# - When the gauge is full, Overdrive can be activated.
# - While active, Overdrive drains over time.
# - When the gauge reaches zero, Overdrive ends.
#
# - Overdrive:
#   - Applies a database State
#   - Changes the character graphic
#   - Allows Overdrive-only skills
#   - Displays a gauge in battle
#
#
# 2. DATABASE SETUP
# -----------------------------
#
# STATES:
# Create a State in the database called "Overdrive".
# Note its ID number.
#
# Set that ID below in OVERDRIVE_STATE.
#
# CHARACTER GRAPHICS:
# Create an alternate character sprite for Overdrive.
#
# Example:
#   Hero.png        (normal)
#   Her
D.png     (overdrive)
#
# The script automatically swaps graphics when active.
#
#
# 3. ACTIVATING OVERDRIVE
# -----------------------------
#
# You can activate Overdrive in:
#
# - A skill damage formula:
#     a.activate_overdrive
#
# - An event Script Call:
#     $game_actors[1].activate_overdrive
#
#
# 4. OVERDRIVE-ONLY SKILLS
# -----------------------------
#
# Example skill damage formula:
#
#   a.overdrive_active? ? a.atk * 5 : 0
#
# If Overdrive is not active, the skill does nothing.
#
#
# 5. OPTIONAL SCRIPT CALLS
# -----------------------------
#
# Fill gauge:
#   $game_actors[1].gain_overdrive(50)
#
# Force end:
#   $game_actors[1].end_overdrive
#
# Check full:
#   a.overdrive_full?
#
# Check active:
#   a.overdrive_active?
#
#
# 6. SAFE NOTES
# -----------------------------
#
# - No plugins required
# - No Unicode
# - No emojis
# - PC compatible
# - Uses only default RGSS3 classes
#
#==================================================
module OverdriveSystem
MAX_GAUGE        = 100
SKILL_GAIN       = 10
DAMAGE_GAIN      = 5
DRAIN_RATE       = 1
OVERDRIVE_STATE  = 21   # CHANGE THIS TO YOUR STATE ID
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Base accessors
#--------------------------------------------------
class Game_BattlerBase
attr_accessor
verdrive
attr_accessor
verdrive_active
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Game_Actor
#--------------------------------------------------
class Game_Actor < Game_Battler
alias od_initialize initialize
def initialize(actor_id)
od_initialize(actor_id)
@overdrive
= 0
@overdrive_active = false
end
def gain_overdrive(value)
return if @overdrive_active
@overdrive
+= value
clamp_overdrive
end
def clamp_overdrive
@overdrive
= 0 if
@overdrive
< 0
@overdrive
= OverdriveSystem::MAX_GAUGE if
@overdrive
> OverdriveSystem::MAX_GAUGE
end
def overdrive_full?
@overdrive
>= OverdriveSystem::MAX_GAUGE
end
def activate_overdrive
return unless overdrive_full?
@overdrive_active = true
add_state(OverdriveSystem:
VERDRIVE_STATE)
end
def end_overdrive
@overdrive
= 0
@overdrive_active = false
remove_state(OverdriveSystem:
VERDRIVE_STATE)
refresh
end
def drain_overdrive
return unless @overdrive_active
@overdrive
-= OverdriveSystem:
RAIN_RATE
end_overdrive if
@overdrive
<= 0
end
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Enemy support (optional)
#--------------------------------------------------
class Game_Enemy < Game_Battler
alias od_enemy_initialize initialize
def initialize(index, enemy_id)
od_enemy_initialize(index, enemy_id)
@overdrive
= 0
@overdrive_active = false
end
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Scene_Battle
#--------------------------------------------------
class Scene_Battle < Scene_Base
alias od_use_item use_item
def use_item
subject = @subject
if subject.is_a?(Game_Actor)
subject.gain_overdrive(OverdriveSystem::SKILL_GAIN)
end
od_use_item
end
alias od_update update
def update
od_update
$game_party.battle_members.each do |actor|
actor.drain_overdrive
end
end
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Damage gain
#--------------------------------------------------
class Game_Action
alias od_apply apply
def apply(target)
od_apply(target)
if target.is_a?(Game_Actor) && target.hp_damage > 0
target.gain_overdrive(OverdriveSystem:
AMAGE_GAIN)
end
end
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Graphic transformation
#--------------------------------------------------
class Game_Actor
alias od_character_name character_name
def character_name
return od_character_name unless @overdrive_active
od_character_name + "_OD"
end
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Gauge drawing
#--------------------------------------------------
class Window_Base < Window
def draw_overdrive_gauge(actor, x, y, width = 96)
rate = actor.overdrive.to_f / OverdriveSystem::MAX_GAUGE
draw_gauge(x, y, width, rate, text_color(18), text_color(20))
draw_text(x, y, width, line_height, "OD", 1)
end
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Battle status window
#--------------------------------------------------
class Window_BattleStatus < Window_Selectable
alias od_draw_item draw_item
def draw_item(index)
od_draw_item(index)
actor = $game_party.battle_members[index]
rect = item_rect(index)
draw_overdrive_gauge(actor, rect.x, rect.y + line_height * 2)
end
end
#--------------------------------------------------
# Helper method
#--------------------------------------------------
class Game_Battler
def overdrive_active?
@overdrive_active
end
end
